description: A session as a host lists it.

id.description: A UUID the host made as it started it (claude's --session-id: what it's resumed by).

title.description: Its title: given, its agent's, or its prompt's start.

cwd.description: The folder its agent runs in.

created.description: When it was made, epoch seconds: the earlier of when the host took it up and its transcript's first record.

said.description: When something was last said in it, epoch seconds.

state.description: working: at a turn; waiting: asking permission; idle: its agent running, between turns; stopped: no agent running.

cli_id.description: The id claude has for it where that's another (a fork's: its transcript's named so).

transcript.description: Where its transcript is on its host's machine (what's on the same machine reads it there rather than fetching a copy).

draft.description: A new chat not written in yet (a head leaves it out of its lists).

written.description: Its transcript's size as its own agent last left it (more since, with it stopped: another program's writing to it).

subagents.description: The mtime of its subagents' newest file (0 for none: what a client's copy is checked against).

commands.description: What its agent is running; none once its agent's gone.

cut.description: When the host process stopped its agent at a turn or asking (shutting down, a quit, a restart), so a head can offer to carry it on; null once a user message is sent to it.

bot.description: A Bot's; null for a chat.

autofix.description: Its Auto-fix: the pull request its host follows for it; null while it's off.

acting.description: Whether its turn is at its tools: from a tool call's start till text starts after it, the turn ends or its agent goes; only while it's working, not asking.

context.description: How much of its context window its agent last said it's used, kept while its agent's stopped; null till it's said.

on_phone.description: A Bot's browser is on a phone now.

fork_from.description: The session it was forked from.

spawned_by.description: The chat whose mesh tools started it (start's spawned_by), or the Bot whose task's run started it.

task_run.description: The task's run that started it (start's task_run), on its Bot's host.

desktop.description: Claude Desktop's: a chat in Claude Desktop's own list on its host's machine. Every app lists it in the Desktop group.

taken_up.description: false for a Claude Desktop chat its host only lists: nothing of it runs on the host till it's written in, which takes it up (as adopt does). Missing for every other.

elsewhere.description: Claude Desktop is writing it now (written in the last minute, not by the host's own agent): every app keeps it read-only while it is.

start_key.description: Its start's start_key, if it was given one.

account.description: The subscription account its agent runs under on its host, fixed as it's made (the host's default for its provider then, or as it's first written in), or the one picked for it since (accounts' use), from the moment it's picked; null for the CLI's own sign-in, or an account since removed (account_gone).

account_gone.description: Its subscription account was removed from its host after it was picked for it: its agent can't start till another is picked.

held.description: Messages held for it, oldest first.

senders.description: Its sender store's revision (0 for none): what a head's copy is checked against.

always_allow.description: The tools allowed whenever it asks for them, sorted.

asks.description: What it's asking, not answered yet.
